name: After § 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: 1i. Stresses the importance of the PDCA as a key tool to promote understanding and mutually beneficial relations between the EU and Cuba; reaffirms its full support for the PDCA between the EU and Cuba as an essential framework for dialogue, cooperation and mutual respect; firmly rejects attempts to undermine this agreement through external pressure, unilateral sanctions or policies of isolation;
